verdicts.about: Take the /writing card's text verbatim from the article's description
verdicts.why: Noticed the right file but stepped back too little: the operator would have dropped the old articles outright, as off-topic for a fractional-CTO site, which the proposal took as given.

verdicts.about: Keep tally.py alone, dropping its tests and its vet job
verdicts.why: Turned down flat: the tests and the vet job stay.

verdicts.about: Recount the article's figures against the notes file on main
verdicts.why: Taken in full: recount against the latest main, and again at finalize if main moves on.

verdicts.about: Have the prose-quotes check fail on -- in served prose too
verdicts.why: Taken: fail on -- in articles and on an em dash in social posts. The operator also asked for /five-percent comments to be labelled visibly, having not known where this one came from.

verdicts.about: Fail curly quotes in channel posts too, or narrow the Voice rule
verdicts.why: The operator took only the narrowing: blogs are meant to carry curly quotes, so the check is not widened to them.
